statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (c : ℝ) (s : ℂ), 1 ≤ c → 1 < s.re → let w : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => if 1 ≤ n ∧ (n : ℝ) < c then ((Real.log c - Real.log (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0; let r : ℕ → ℂ := (Real.log c : ℂ) • LSeries.delta - LSeries.convolution (fun n : ℕ => (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℂ)) w; LSeries (fun n : ℕ => χ (n : ZMod N) * r n) s = (Real.log c : ℂ) - LSeries (fun n : ℕ => χ (n : ZMod N) * w n) s / χ.LFunction s

plain_statement.zh: 对每个正模数的狄利克雷特征 χ，令 w 为支于 1≤n<c 的对数权，r=(log c)δ−μ∗w。在 c≥1、Re(s)>1 时，r 的 χ 扭曲级数等于 log c 减去 w 的有限 χ 扭曲级数除以 L(s,χ)。
plain_statement.en: For every Dirichlet character χ of positive modulus, let w be the logarithmic cutoff on 1≤n<c and r=(log c)δ−μ∗w. If c≥1 and Re(s)>1, the χ-twisted series of r equals log c minus the finite χ-twisted series of w divided by L(s,χ).

brief.zh: 对狄利克雷卷积作同一特征的扭曲，利用绝对收敛和扭曲莫比乌斯级数的倒数恒等式。该等式在实部大于一的区域成立，无需零点分布假设。
brief.en: Twist the Dirichlet convolution by the same character and use absolute convergence and the reciprocal identity for the twisted Möbius series. The half-plane Re(s)>1 suffices without a zero-location hypothesis.
